text: Read-only audit of skills/run-harness/scripts: assess organization, efficiency, robustness, error handling, resilience, agent usability, maintainability, testability, context preservation in long runs, and portability across Codex, Claude, Pi, OpenCode, and Cursor; propose prioritized improvements without changing code.

Audit complete: 59/59 tests pass and core modules have strong line coverage, but unattended long-run robustness is not yet adequate. Highest risks are missing single-controller lease, duplicate live orphan workers on resume, prompt-only read/write boundaries, verification commands not enforced by the controller, BLOCKED_CONTEXT not mapped to blocked state, unversioned mutable run artifacts, and semantic loss from prefix-truncated handoffs.

Prioritize a hardening slice: controller lease plus worker process identity and termination escalation; structured worker result including blocked_context; controller-owned deterministic verification and unexpected-write detection; then schema/version fingerprints, semantic handoff budgeting, driver adapters, CI, and concurrency fault tests.
